name: Sand (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, yellow at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sand: a blue shield with a yellow crown and a bunch of grapes, within a green wreath, below a scroll inscribed SAND.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sand arms with wreath and scroll
